# LoadingSpinner

`@kerfjs/ui:loading-spinner` · Kerf UI · component · Feedback

## When to use

Meaningfully labeled or decorative progress.

- Show compact labeled or decorative indeterminate activity in Kerf UI.

**Not when:**

- Do not use for known progress.

**Alternatives:**

- [Spinner](./wa-spinner.md) (prefer-over)
- [Progress Bar](./wa-progress-bar.md) (prefer-over)
- [Progress Ring](./wa-progress-ring.md) (prefer-over)

## Imports

- JavaScript: `@kerfjs/ui/loading-spinner` — exports `LoadingSpinner`.
- CSS: the browser build of `@kerfjs/ui/loading-spinner` pulls its CSS automatically; import `@kerfjs/ui/loading-spinner.css` manually only without the `browser` export condition.
- Declared side effects: browser-condition-css.

## Props

Exact prop names and types: [`@kerfjs/ui/loading-spinner`](../public-api-signatures-v1.md#kerfjsuiloading-spinner) in `public-api-signatures-v1.md`. Do not infer props from examples.

**Variants (configure, do not restyle):**

- labeled
- decorative
- sized

## Composition

- Parents: any.
- Contexts: `application-ui`.
- Children: unrestricted.

## State and wiring

**The app owns:** loading lifecycle; adjacent status copy.

No wiring helper.

## Geometry

Margin: none · border: none · padding: none (layout role: feedback). `self` means the component already owns it — do not add wrapper padding, margin, or borders around it.

## Accessibility

- Labeled spinners use role img; decorative spinners are hidden and stop for reduced motion.

## Styling boundary

The component owns its own styles. Configure it through its props and variants; do not override its internals.

Public class hooks (select for layout placement only, never to change the component's look): `kui-loading-spinner`.

Never put `kui-loading-spinner` on an element you write; render `LoadingSpinner` instead (`KUI-L103`).

Everything else is internal: `kerf-ui-analyze` reports private or unknown `.kui-*` selectors (`KUI-L001`, `KUI-L010`), unknown or private tokens (`KUI-L002`, `KUI-L012`), and any application rule that restyles the component, forced dimensions included (`KUI-L019`).
